prompt: You run `rladmin status nodes` on one node of a three-node cluster and see the output above. Which statement is correct?
explanation: In `rladmin status` output the asterisk marks the node you are connected to, so the session is on node:2, and the ROLE column shows it is a secondary (slave) node. node:1 holds the master role but the asterisk sits on node:2, node:3 is fine with zero shards (a node can simply host no shards), and nothing in the output indicates maintenance mode — a node in maintenance shows a 0/0 shards value.
code:
CLUSTER NODES:
NODE:ID   ROLE     ADDRESS       HOSTNAME      SHARDS   STATUS
node:1    master   172.17.0.2    rp1_node1     2/100    OK
*node:2   slave    172.17.0.4    rp2_node1     2/100    OK
node:3    slave    172.17.0.3    rp3_node1     0/100    OK

options.text: You are connected to node:2, which is currently a secondary (slave) node
You are connected to node:1, the cluster master
node:3 is unhealthy because it hosts no shards
node:1 has been placed in maintenance mode
